service:
# com.example.relay-agent: the host agent "agent" of the Home Hub plugin "relay", written by scripts/install-host-agent.mjs.
[Unit]
Description=Relay agent (Home Hub plugin relay)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart="/opt/node/bin/node" "<T>/agent/plugins/relay/scripts/agent.mjs"
WorkingDirectory=<T>/agent
Environment="PATH=/opt/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Environment="RELAY_MODE=test"
Environment="HOME=<T>/home"
Environment="HOME_HUB_HOME=<T>/agent"
Environment="HOME_HUB_AGENT_SOCKET=<T>/agent/private/a.sock"
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=append:<T>/home/logs/com.example.relay-agent.out.log
StandardError=append:<T>/home/logs/com.example.relay-agent.err.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
